core.demo.account.participant.descriptio: A volunteer with a profile. Signs up for {term_shift_plural} and keeps their own details up to date.
core.demo.account.newcomer.description: Just signed up and has no profile yet. Shows the first sign-in steps.
core.demo.account.lead.description: Runs their {term_department_plural}: builds {term_shift_plural}, manages members, verifies {term_qualification_plural}, sees rosters.
core.demo.account.coordinator.descriptio: Finds volunteers across every {term_department}: sees rosters, contact details and {term_qualification_plural}.
core.demo.account.steward.description: Creates and archives {term_department_plural} and appoints their {term_lead_plural}.
core.demo.account.event-admin.descriptio: Sets up each {term_event}: its dates and schedule.
core.demo.account.settings-admin.descrip: Sets the site's name, logo, words and module settings.
core.demo.account.account-admin.descript: Manages accounts and profiles, including contact details and deletion requests.
core.demo.account.access-admin.descripti: Decides who holds which role, and edits the roles.
core.demo.account.audit-reviewer.descrip: Reads the audit log of who saw or changed sensitive information.
core.demo.mail.title: Captured mail
core.demo.mail.note: Only mail sent to your own account's address appears here.
core.demo.mail.empty: No mail has been captured yet. Mail the demo would send appears here instead of being delivered.
core.demo.mail.off: This is not a demo instance.
